name: How long does a water-wise landscape design and installation project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a water-wise landscape design and installation project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a water-wise landscape project varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the area, the specific design elements, and material availability. A typical residential project, from initial consultation and design to final installation, can range from 4 to 12 weeks. Smaller projects, like a front yard renovation, might be completed faster, while extensive re-landscaping or those involving hardscaping, drainage, and complex planting schemes will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines for water-wise landscaping vary from 4 to 12 weeks, depending on complexity and size. Smaller projects are quicker, while larger ones with hardscaping take longer.
